title: model
description: A model record (RFC-020), optional: data/models/<model_id>.yaml. A model is onboarded once for the project and used by any experiment's arms: its build on every machine that runs it, what it can do, the settings chosen for it and the smoke behind them. `aliases` are the ids runs record for it (params.model); the arms page's weights filter and the catalog's Models page read the records.

model_id.description: The record's id: its file's name.

name.description: A display name, when the id is not enough.

aliases.description: The ids runs record for this model (params.model): a gateway alias, an Ollama tag, a Hugging Face repo.

weights.description: open: the weights can be downloaded; proprietary: only its vendor serves it.

licence.description: The licence of open weights, as its publisher states it.

builds.description: One entry per place the model runs.

where.description: A machine (x3, dgx, mac) or a host (openrouter, a gateway).

server.description: What serves it there, with its version: "ollama 0.40.13", "vllm 26.05".

server_settings.description: The server's settings that change the model's behaviour: context length, KV cache, flash attention.

provider_id.description: A hosted model's id at its provider.

endpoint.description: How to reach this build for onboarding: a built-in provider (openai for an OpenAI-shaped server such as Ollama or vLLM, litellm, openrouter, anthropic), its base_url, the model name there, and api_key_env when it needs a key.

checked_at.description: When the build there was last checked (ISO date or time).

capabilities.description: What the model can do, as measured.

reasons.description: It reasons before answering by default.

reasoning_off.description: The setting that turns reasoning off ("reasoning_effort: none"), or null when it cannot be turned off.

deterministic.description: The same request twice gave the same output on the machine it was checked on.

outputs.description: An ML model's labels or output shape.

settings.description: The settings chosen for it, passed to every arm that names the record (an arm may override them).

settings_why.description: One line per setting: why it was chosen.

smokes.description: The latest arm smoke (evh arm-smoke) of each arm that names the record, by config id.
